name: No_2
short_caption: The robot raises its right hand forward with palm facing out to signal a polite refusal, stop, or disagreement.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot raises its right arm forward with the hand open and palm facing outwards. The hand is held up momentarily around chest height as if indicating a 'stop' or 'no' gesture, while the head and left arm remain still. Finally, the right arm smoothly lowers back down to the side, returning the robot to its neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The right arm extends directly forward. Ensure there are no obstacles or people directly in front of the robot's right side within a arm's reach.
